items.problem: Bootstrap omitted external files referenced by UWP project Include/Link metadata.
items.evidence: session-log.txt turns 2 and 5-18: bootstrap copied six files, while the csproj linked the shared App/MainPage code and XAML, Styles.xaml, three scenario XAML files, and assets.
items.skill_search: Initialize-UwpMigration.ps1 searched for Include, Link, Compile, Page, Content, and SharedContent; no linked-item handling existed.
items.root_cause: The script used only Get-ChildItem -Recurse under -Source, so project items outside that directory were invisible.
items.proposed_fix: Parse resolvable Include/Link items from the UWP csproj and copy them to their logical Link paths before namespace rewrite and triage.
items.generalizes: Linked files and shared content projects are common in UWP SDK samples and multi-project UWP applications.

items.problem: Validator emitted a false deferred-file warning for the bootstrap's empty placeholder row.
items.evidence: session-log.txt lines 3951-3964 and 3970-3981: validation passed but warned even though MIGRATION-DEFERRED.md contained only '| (none) | — |'.
items.skill_search: Validate-UwpMigration.ps1 search for '(none)' and 'mapping has no defer rows'; the placeholder was not excluded.
items.wrong_text_if_any: Initialize-UwpMigration.ps1 writes '| (none) | — |', while Validate-UwpMigration.ps1 treated any file lacking 'No items deferred' as non-empty.
items.root_cause: Bootstrap and validator used incompatible empty-state representations.
items.proposed_fix: Exclude '(none)' from deferred data-row parsing in both zero-row and row-count branches.
items.generalizes: Every migration with no deferred files receives this bootstrap-generated placeholder.

items.problem: Compiled-binding guidance did not distinguish a WMC0909 root error from cascading WMC1111/WMC9999 errors.
items.evidence: session-log.txt lines 3833-3847; changing the unresolved DataTemplate x:Bind to Binding cleared the complete diagnostic chain.
items.skill_search: MIGRATION-PATTERNS.md searches for WMC0909, WMC1111, DataTemplate, and x:DataType returned no diagnostic recipe; the x:Bind section claimed types resolve automatically.
items.wrong_text_if_any: Compiled bindings against Windows.UI.Xaml.* types resolve to Microsoft.UI.Xaml.* automatically once the namespace rewrites land.
items.root_cause: The documentation treated WMC9999 as an independent resource-key failure and omitted local model resolution failures.
items.proposed_fix: Document the WMC0909-first diagnostic chain, type visibility/namespace/build checks, and the Binding fallback for simple templates.
items.generalizes: UWP pages frequently use x:Bind DataTemplates whose local model namespaces or build inclusion change during shell conversion.

items.problem: Project reconciliation omitted source minimum-OS preservation and CA1416 handling.
items.evidence: session-log.txt turns 21-24: six CA1416 warnings caused three edits before TargetPlatformMinVersion was raised.
items.skill_search: MIGRATION-PATTERNS.md searches for CA1416 and TargetPlatformMinVersion found no guidance.
items.root_cause: The scaffold minimum was lower than the UWP source minimum, making retained Windows APIs appear unsupported.
items.proposed_fix: Tell agents to compare source and target minimum OS versions, carry forward the higher source requirement, and reserve annotations/guards for intentional older-OS support.
items.generalizes: WinUI scaffolds and UWP projects commonly have different minimum Windows versions.
